camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateNetworkDomain --region cn-hangzhou --Proxies.1.Address '47.104.00.00' --Comment comment --NetworkDomainName SSH_Proxy --Proxies.1.NodeType Master --Proxies.1.Port 22 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-lbj3bw4ma02' --Proxies.1.ProxyType SSHProxy --ProjectId 3 --Proxies.1.Password 'UWdi000000Ng==' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NetworkDomainType Proxy --Proxies.1.User root --method POST --force
description_en: To centrally manage assets that are distributed across different network environments or that cannot communicate with the virtual private cloud (VPC) where Bastionhost is deployed, use the network domain feature of Bastionhost. You can configure a proxy server for these assets, create a network domain in Bastionhost, add the proxy server to the network domain, and then add the assets to the network domain. This way, you can manage the assets through Bastionhost
description_zh: 如果您想统一运维分布在不同网络环境中或与堡垒机所在专有网络（VPC）网络不互通的资产，推荐使用堡垒机的网络域功能。您可以为这些资产配置一台代理服务器，然后在堡垒机中创建网络域并添加代理服务器，将资产加入该网络域后即可通过堡垒机运维资产
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-lbj3bw4ma02 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-name SSH_Proxy --network-domain-type Proxy --comment comment --proxies User=root Address=47.104.00.00 NodeType=Master Port=22 ProxyType=SSHProxy Password=UWdi000000Ng== --project-id 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNetworkDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance for which you want to create a network domain.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建网络域的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance for which you want to create a network domain.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建网络域的堡垒机的地域ID。
区域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the network domain to create. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定要创建的网络域名称，最大128字符
parameters.name: network_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network domain to create. Valid values:
Direct: The bastion host directly connects to the asset network without going through an intermediate proxy server.
Proxy: When the asset network cannot communicate with the bastion host network, a proxy server forwards network requests to enable O&M on assets in different network environments
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建的网络域类型。取值：
Direct：直连，表示堡垒机直接和资产网络连通，不经过中间代理服务器。
Proxy：代理，资产所在网络与堡垒机网络不通的情况下，可以通过代理服务器转发网络请求，实现对不同网络环境下的资产进行运维
parameters.name: network_domain_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the network domain. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 网络域的备注。最多500字符
parameters.name: comment

fields.help_en: The address of the proxy server
fields.name: address

fields.help_en:
The node type of the proxy server. Valid values:

Master: primary proxy server.
Slave: secondary proxy server
fields.help_zh:
代理服务器节点。取值：

Master：主代理服务器
Slave：备代理服务器
fields.name: node_type

fields.help_en: The Base64-encoded password of the proxy server account
fields.help_zh: Base64处理后的代理服务器账户的密码
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The Server Port of the proxy server
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The proxy type. Valid values:
SSHProxy: SSH proxy.
HTTPProxy: HTTP proxy.
Socks5Proxy: SOCKS proxy
fields.help_zh:
代理方式。取值：
SSHProxy：SSH代理
HTTPProxy：HTTP代理
Socks5Proxy：Socks代理
fields.name: proxy_type

fields.help_en: The account of the proxy server
fields.name: user

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
